projects.name: KSE-Platform
projects.description: The SCADA system is actively deployed at industrial facilities within the oil and gas sector. Its primary customers include companies such as Gazprom, Rosneft, and Bashneft.
responsibilities: Developed and executed test plans for SCADA system components – including RTUs, PLCs, HMI interfaces, and communication protocols to ensure reliable data acquisition and control functionality
Performed regression and integration testing after system updates or configuration changes, validating alarm handling, historical data logging, and overall Runtime and Studio stability
Developed a server for distributing accompanying technical documentation for the KSE Platform
Developed a platform based on Spring Boot and JavaFX for running automated tests
Developed test cases and reports within the platform for automated testing of the SCADA system

projects.description: Worked as part of a dedicated team responsible for Keycloak development. Within the company's overall architecture, Keycloak served as the central authorization point for bank employees and clients.
responsibilities: Development of themes for Keycloak
Development of new authorization flows within Keycloak
Implementation of information security (IS) requirements
Writing integration tests
Development of new microservices (implementation of QR-based authorization)

Implementation of business requirements

Conducting code review
